title: refactor(ci): consolidate workflows, bump actions & deps, optimize cache
description: Motivation: Our GH Actions workflows have diverged and accumulated duplicated steps across lint/test/release pipelines. This PR consolidates the common lint/test/release logic into a smaller set of reusable workflows, bumps key GH Actions and Node versions, and improves cache keys to avoid frequent cold caches. Changes are intended to reduce CI runtime, improve cache-hit stability, and simplify maintenance. Checklist: - [x] consolidate lint+test jobs into shared workflow templates - [x] update action versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/cache@v4, actions/setup-node@v4) - [x] bump node matrix to node16/node18/node20 (primary: node18,node20) - [x] improve cache keys (repo + hash of package-lock + job-specific suffix) - [x] add job-level concurrency and workflow-level concurrency for release jobs - [x] fix flaky e2e by increasing Jest timeout and isolating integration DB steps - [ ] monitor CI on main for 72 hours and revert if regressions observed
author: Ava Martinez
commits: a1c2d3f: add reusable workflow templates for lint and test
b2d3e4f: update actions/checkout to v4 and actions/setup-node to v4
c3e4f5a: improve cache key strategy and add job-level cache boundaries
d4f5a6b: increase jest timeout for flaky integration tests
e5a6b7c: add workflow concurrency for release jobs and concurrency groups
files_changed: .github/workflows/test.yml (replaced multiple per-repo matrices with a single template call)
.github/workflows/release.yml (added workflow-level concurrency and serialized release group)
scripts/ci/cache-key.sh (new helper to compute stable cache keys)
ci/jest.config.js (increase default timeout for integration tests by 50%)
review_comments: Liam Chen: Great consolidation - can we add an explicit note about matrix size caps for repo-level workloads? (answered: limited to 6 concurrent rows by template param)
Priya Nair: Please ensure actions/cache key includes package-lock checksum to avoid cross-PR poisoning. (done: cache-key helper includes lockfile hash)
Daniel Park: I saw one flaky e2e locally; bumping Jest timeout seems reasonable - please open a follow-up to investigate root cause (added follow-up item ENG-12111)
Ava Martinez (author): replied to comments and updated templates to expose matrix caps and cache suffixes as inputs
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows and upgraded GH Actions versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/cache@v4, actions/setup-node@v4). Improved caching keys and concurrency for release workflows. Expected CI runtime and cache stability improvements.
